{{Quote|The Rift Alliance controls critical resources, armies, trade centers. If they leave, the Republic will die.|Supreme Chancellor Dorian Janarus, to the Barsen'thor|<ref name="TOR:AAoO">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|An Alliance of Opposites|''Defender''-class corvette}}</ref>}}
The '''Rift Alliance''' was a [[Politics|political]] faction and [[Rift Alliance Coalition Forces|militant]] group in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] formed of Republic or Republic-aligned [[Planet/Legends|planets]] united by their shared protests at the Republic "incompetence", they threatened to secede from the Republic. Without these worlds, the Republic would have collapsed. However, despite being originally hostile, the Rift Alliance was united by a [[The Barsen'thor|powerful Jedi Master]] to [[Rift Alliance campaign|stand against]] the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and provided their rich resources to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]'s cause.

==History==
[[File:Senator_Alauni.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Senator Alauni of Saleucami]]
Rift Alliance member [[Alauni]] represented [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]], the Republic's most powerful trade hub in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], while [[Aeten II/Legends|Aeten II]]—[[Diab Duin]]'s world—produced vital ores and crystals for Republic fleet construction. As tensions with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] rose, supplies of the healing fluid [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] from [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]—[[Shuuru]]'s world—became indispensable. The planet [[Erigorm]], represented by [[Augin Blaesus]], recorded and administrated the Republic's finances for centuries; its secession would have destroyed the Republic's financial markets.

Not all members of the Rift Alliance were hostile toward the Republic, however. [[Tai Cordan]], a member of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra's]] exiled government, claimed to be seeking powerful allies to help his home. Senator [[Tobas Grell]] and his daughter [[Nadia Grell|Nadia]], representing the newly-joined planet [[Sarkhai/Legends|Sarkhai]], joined out of curiosity.<ref>{{TORcite|type=codex|The Rift Alliance}}</ref>

The Rift Alliance pooled its economic and military resources together for their mutual protection. A research facility was established on the planet [[Quesh]] that was jointly run by the Rift Alliance worlds, though staffed primarily by [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]]. Additionally, troops from the member worlds formed a coalition force to combat the [[White Maw]] pirates based on the ice planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], which harassed trade routes important to the Rift Alliance world.

[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Dorian Janarus]] knew how devastating the loss of these systems would be and recruited the Jedi Master known as the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] to keep them with the Republic. The Barsen'thor would ultimately rally the Rift Alliance into a formidable army to battle the [[Children of the Emperor]], culminating in a showdown against [[Syo Bakarn|the First Son]] at the climax of the [[Battle of Corellia]]. After Janarus' assassination,<ref name="Number One With a Bullet">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Number One With a Bullet|the ''Founder''}}</ref> his successor, Supreme Chancellor [[Leontyne Saresh]], authorized substantial reparations to the Rift Alliance both in response to their original protests, as well as in gratitude for their efforts to preserve the Republic.<ref name="Chaos and Harmony">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Chaos and Harmony|Coruscant}}</ref>

[[File:Rift_Alliance.png|thumb|left|Rift Alliance on the Barsen'thor's ship]]
It is interesting to note that while the Rift Alliance was nominally a separatist movement, at least half of the members of the Alliance were not secessionists. Balmorra and Manaan were neutral worlds, and thus were not members of the Republic to begin with, while Sarkhai had no apparent intention to secede, as its representatives joined only out of curiosity.

It is also curious that Manaan, despite its longstanding neutrality, would send troops and military aid to Hoth, although scientific support for offworlders was not without precedent, as Selkath scientists had secretly supported the Republic at the [[Hrakert Rift]] station, while the [[Order of Shasa]] was protecting the research facility operated by the [[Order of Revan]] on Manaan during this same period.

Several years after the Barsen'thor's stint with the Rift Alliance, Jedi Master [[Kutri O'a]] foresaw that in one possible future scenario, an organization called the '''New Rift Alliance''' would be formed, and its members would heavily rely on the Barsen'thor's teachings, preserved in his [[Third Barsen'thor's holocron|holocron]].<ref name="Barsen'thor's Legacy">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=class|Jedi Consular|Barsen'thor's Legacy|Rishi}}</ref>
